articles.title: Man dead in kitchen fire in Toronto's St. James Town neighbourhood
articles.summary: One person is dead after a "cooking-related" incident, according to Toronto Fire.

articles.title: 2nd fatal highrise fire reported in Toronto following ‘cooking-related incident’
articles.summary: Toronto Fire is dealing with multiple serious highrise fires across the city Tuesday, including two fatal investigations — one in Scarborough and another at a St. James Town apartment tower. Toronto Fire confirms they are now investigating a fatal fire at a 29‑storey apartment building in the Wellesley Street East area near St. James Avenue. […]

articles.summary: Toronto Fire crews rescued a man from a remote area of the Scarborough Bluffs on Tuesday morning after he had been stuck there for approximately 24 hours. articles.title: Motorcyclist dead following vehicle collision in Brampton: police
articles.summary: A motorcyclist is dead following a collision with a vehicle in Brampton Tuesday morning, Peel police say.

articles.title: 1 person dead in Scarborough apartment fire
articles.summary: One person is dead after a fire broke out in a Scarborough apartment building near Neilson Road and McLevin Avenue Tuesday morning, Toronto paramedics say.

articles.summary: One person has died following a two‑alarm fire inside a 20‑storey apartment building in Scarborough early Tuesday. articles.title: Male motorcyclist dead following collision in Brampton
articles.summary: Peel Regional Police (PRP) say an adult male motorcyclist was killed following an early-morning collision with another vehicle in Brampton. Officers were notified of a crash involving the driver of a Sedan and a motorcyclist just after 7:30 a.m. on Tuesday in the area of Sun Pac Boulevard and Queen Street East, near Goreway Drive. […]

articles.title: Canadian 'vigilantes' confronted New York sex offender 2 years before arrest
articles.summary: The FBI investigated a New York man in 2024 after Canadian 'vigilantes' confronted him and warned he had travelled to sexually abuse a minor. It took another two years and a girl’s disappearance for the man to be arrested and charged, according to U.S. court records reviewed by CBC News.

articles.title: Toronto native Evan Gold named Hamilton Hammers GM
articles.summary: The New York Islanders announced Monday that Evan Gold has been hired as general manager of the Hamilton Hammers, the club's American Hockey League (AHL) affiliate.

articles.title: 2 women dead after Highway 401 collision near Gananoque
articles.summary: Two women from the Greater Toronto Area were killed Monday after their vehicle hit a tractor-trailer parked on the shoulder of Highway 401 near Gananoque, Ont., according to the Ontario Provincial Police.

articles.title: Man, 29, dead after being struck by pickup truck in Downsview Park parking lot: police
articles.summary: Toronto police say a man is dead after being struck by a pickup truck in a Downsview Park parking lot Friday.

articles.title: 9th annual Taste of India festival transforms Nathan Phillips Square
articles.summary: The ninth annual Taste of India festival took over Nathan Phillips Square this weekend. Plenty of people showed up to take in the sights, sounds, and tastes of the celebration, despite its rainy second day. Mercedes Gaztambide has the highlights.
